---
applyTo: "ClinicManagementSystem.Blazor/**/*"
---

# Blazor Layer Instructions

- Keep UI components focused on presentation and interaction flow.
- Move business and data access logic into service abstractions.
- Validate user inputs both client side (for UX) and server side (for security).
- Do not embed secrets or environment-specific sensitive values in client-delivered code.
- Keep accessibility in mind: labels, keyboard interactions, and semantic markup.
- Preserve existing visual patterns unless the task requests UI redesign.
